title: Soil moisture, top 10 cm (NASA GLDAS)
title_hi: मिट्टी की नमी, ऊपरी 10 सेमी (NASA GLDAS)
mission: NASA GLDAS-2.1 Noah land surface model (uses satellite + ground observations), monthly, 1 degree
citation: Beaudoing, H. and M. Rodell, NASA/GSFC/HSL, 2020: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model L4 monthly 1.0 x 1.0 degree V2.1. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/LWTYSMP3VM5Z ; Rodell, M. et al., 2004, Bull. Amer. Meteor. Soc. 85, 381-394.
